title: Nicaragua to receive emergency funding following devastation left by Eta and Iota
methodology: Project approval announcement with local vulnerability context.
limitations: Plans are not completed results; no attribution of either storm to climate change.

title: Nicaragua, climate resilience of rural households in the Dry Corridor: final evaluation
methodology: Publisher's substantive summary of an evaluation.
limitations: Full report not inspected; summary calls for continued support and only partial institutionalization.

title: Nicaragua country overview
methodology: Operational country summary; Spanish text inspected.
limitations: Rolling page; no dated causal estimates or nationally representative subnational rates extracted.

title: 2025 Annual Report, Chapter IV.B: Nicaragua
temporal_coverage: Country conditions and cited events through 2025; climate impacts include El Niño conditions in 2024.
methodology: IACHR Nicaragua chapter; full PDF inspected.
limitations: Synthesis cites WFP/FAO/WMO; Dry Corridor only, without municipalities or event attribution.

title: Violencia contra pueblos indígenas y afrodescendientes de la Costa Caribe en Nicaragua
temporal_coverage: Historical violence and institutional developments through 2024; report approved 25 August 2025.
methodology: Original 133-page Spanish IACHR thematic report inspected in full.
limitations: The report documents rights and violence, not climate-event impacts; its climate connection concerns radio coverage of local environmental and climate issues.

title: Nicaragua realizó el lanzamiento del Sistema Nacional de Respuesta a Emergencia de Nicaragua (SINAREM)
organization: Sistema Nacional para la Prevención, Mitigación y Atención de Desastres (SINAPRED)
temporal_coverage: SINAREM launch and design announcement, February 2025.
methodology: Full official SINAPRED announcement page opened.
limitations: Government announcement describes intended functions and launch, not operational reach or independently evaluated effectiveness.

title: Nicaragua country strategic plan (2024–2029), Revision 02
temporal_coverage: Strategic plan for 2024–2029; Revision 02 approved September 2026.
methodology: WFP publisher page and its substantive plan and outcome summary inspected.
limitations: The linked plan PDF returned an anti-robot challenge; page summary records commitments, not delivered outcomes, and gives no local target areas.
